agent.first_message: Helvetia Werkstoffe, accounts department. How can I help you?

_notes.language: Set to English for building and rehearsal. FR-033a requires a German fallback for unrecognised numbers, and that is delivered per call by the conversation initiation webhook (T076) from the default_language policy parameter — not by this value, which applies only when the webhook does not answer. Change default_language in SSM rather than editing here.
_notes.first_message: Matches the language above. Superseded per call by the initiation webhook so the greeting arrives in the caller's stored language. Uses no name and does not acknowledge that the number was recognised (FR-033b).
_notes.temperature: Low. This agent reads statuses back to callers and follows a policy; inventiveness is a defect here, not a feature.
_notes.turn_timeout: 10s. Callers checking a banking app for a payment date need thinking time, and the agent explicitly offers to wait.
_notes.system_tools: language_detection for DE/FR/IT/EN, and transfer_to_number for the escalation handoff. Both are configured at the platform level rather than in this file.
_notes.asr: scribe_realtime. The original 'elevenlabs' provider was removed and existing agents migrated; specifying it is now rejected.
_notes.phone_number: +1 656 223 0845 (phnum_5701m1k7hybefhvvh8j28rz577e2), imported from Twilio and assigned to this agent. A number routes to exactly one agent, which is why this project uses its own rather than sharing.
_notes.dynamic_variables: Empty. candidate_customer_id was referenced by verify_identity before the conversation initiation webhook existed to supply it, and ElevenLabs refuses to start a session whose tools reference an unresolvable variable — an agent-level placeholder does not satisfy that check. It returns with T076, when the webhook can actually provide it. The handler already treats a missing candidate as an unrecognised number.
_notes.tts: eleven_turbo_v2 is English-only, and ElevenLabs requires it (or flash v2) whenever the agent's base language is English. This is a rehearsal setting. The multilingual requirement in FR-033 needs eleven_turbo_v2_5 with a non-English base and language presets for de/fr/it/en, which lands in T080 — at which point this reverts.
